+fn confirm_campaign_start(campaign: &deadreckon_core::campaign::Campaign, yes: bool) -> Result<()> {
+    if yes {
+        return Ok(());
+    }
+    let prompt = format!(
+        "launch {} sub-orchestrators for \"{}\"?",
+        campaign.n, campaign.root_goal
+    );
+    if prompt::confirm(&prompt, false)? {
+        Ok(())
+    } else {
+        Err(CliError::Core(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
+            "campaign cancelled".to_string(),
+        )))
+    }
+}

+/// Create a promoted result run from the composed campaign tree, binding the
+/// roll-up into the marker signature. Mirrors `create_merged_plan_run`.
+fn promote_campaign_result(
+    paths: &DeadreckonPaths,
+    campaign_id: &str,
+    merge_dir: &Path,
+    rollup: &deadreckon_core::campaign::CampaignRollup,
+) -> Result<deadreckon_core::PipelineState> {
+    let cwd = std::env::current_dir()?;
+    let mut state = create_run(
+        paths,
+        RunOptions {
+            goal: format!("campaign {}", run_prefix(campaign_id)),
+            cwd,
+            sandbox: "none".to_string(),
+            provider: Some("deadreckon:campaign".to_string()),
+            skill_name: "default-coding".to_string(),
+            max_spend_usd: None,
+            max_wall_seconds: None,
+            run_id: None,
+            codebase: None,
+        },
+    )?;
+    remove_if_exists(&state.working_dir)?;
+    copy_tree(merge_dir, &state.working_dir)?;
+    deadreckon_core::campaign::write_campaign_rollup_at_run_root(&state.run_root, rollup)?;
+    write_acceptance_marker(
+        &state.run_root,
+        state.run_id.clone(),
+        state.working_dir.clone(),
+        1,
+    )?;
+    state.set_phase_status(PhaseId(60), PhaseStatus::Completed)?;
+    save_state(&state)?;
+    promote_completed_run(paths, &mut state)?;
+    Ok(state)
+}

+use std::process::Command;
+
+use deadreckon_core::DeadreckonPaths;
+use tempfile::TempDir;
+
+fn deadreckon(paths: &DeadreckonPaths) -> Command {
+    let mut command = Command::new(env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_deadreckon"));
+    command.env("DEADRECKON_HOME", paths.home());
+    command
+}
+
+fn stdout(output: &std::process::Output) -> String {
+    String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string()
+}
+
+fn stderr(output: &std::process::Output) -> String {
+    String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).to_string()
+}
+
+fn workdir(temp: &TempDir) -> std::path::PathBuf {
+    let work = temp.path().join("work");
+    std::fs::create_dir_all(&work).expect("workdir");
+    work
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn campaign_preview_writes_campaign_json_and_stops() {
+    let temp = TempDir::new().expect("tempdir");
+    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::from_home(temp.path().join("home"));
+    let work = workdir(&temp);
+
+    let output = deadreckon(&paths)
+        .current_dir(&work)
+        .args([
+            "campaign",
+            "build a thing",
+            "--n",
+            "2",
+            "--planner-provider",
+            "smoke",
+            "--provider",
+            "smoke",
+            "--preview",
+        ])
+        .output()
+        .expect("run campaign --preview");
+    assert!(
+        output.status.success(),
+        "{}{}",
+        stdout(&output),
+        stderr(&output)
+    );
+
+    // A campaign.json was written, and the run stopped before any merge.
+    let plans = paths.home().join("plans");
+    let mut campaign_json = None;
+    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(&plans).expect("plans dir") {
+        let dir = entry.expect("entry").path();
+        let candidate = dir.join("campaign.json");
+        if candidate.is_file() {
+            campaign_json = Some((dir, candidate));
+        }
+    }
+    let (dir, candidate) =
+        campaign_json.unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("campaign.json not written: {}", stdout(&output)));
+    let body = std::fs::read_to_string(&candidate).expect("read campaign.json");
+    assert!(body.contains("\"n\": 2"), "{body}");
+    assert!(body.contains("\"status\": \"pending\""), "{body}");
+    // Preview stops before fork: no merge-working dir.
+    assert!(!dir.join("merge-working").exists());
+}
+
+#[test]
+fn campaign_preflight_shows_depth_cap_and_tree_budget() {
+    let temp = TempDir::new().expect("tempdir");
+    let paths = DeadreckonPaths::from_home(temp.path().join("home"));
+    let work = workdir(&temp);
+
+    let output = deadreckon(&paths)
+        .current_dir(&work)
+        .args([
+            "campaign",
+            "build a thing",
+            "--n",
+            "2",
+            "--planner-provider",
+            "smoke",
+            "--provider",
+            "smoke",
+            "--max-spend",
+            "10",
+            "--preview",
+        ])
+        .output()
+        .expect("run campaign preflight");
+    assert!(
+        output.status.success(),
+        "{}{}",
+        stdout(&output),
+        stderr(&output)
+    );
+    let out = stdout(&output);
+    assert!(out.contains("depth cap 2"), "{out}");
+    assert!(out.contains("tree budget $10"), "{out}");
+}
+
+#[test]

+    for n in ["1", "7"] {

79	/// Guard a requested campaign against the depth cap and ancestor cycles.
80	///
81	/// `current_depth` is the depth of the process requesting the campaign (0 for a
82	/// top-level invocation, 1 for a sub-orchestrator). The sub-orchestrators a
83	/// campaign launches sit at `current_depth + 1`; if that would reach
84	/// [`CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH`] the campaign is refused. A requested sub-goal whose
85	/// `task_key` or resolved scope matches an ancestor's is refused as a cycle.
86	pub fn guard(
87	    current_depth: u32,
88	    ancestor_task_keys: &[String],
89	    ancestor_scopes: &[String],
90	    requested_sub_task_keys: &[String],
91	    requested_sub_scopes: &[String],
92	) -> Result<()> {
93	    if current_depth + 1 >= CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH {
94	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
95	            "campaign refused: depth cap {CAMPAIGN_MAX_DEPTH} reached\n\
96	             try: run `orchestrate full-plan` (not campaign) inside a sub-orchestrator"
97	        )));
98	    }
99	    for key in requested_sub_task_keys {
100	        if ancestor_task_keys.iter().any(|ancestor| ancestor == key) {
101	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
102	                "campaign refused: sub-goal task_key '{key}' cycles to an ancestor\n\
103	                 try: reword the sub-goal so its task differs from an ancestor"
104	            )));
105	        }
106	    }
107	    for scope in requested_sub_scopes {
108	        if ancestor_scopes.iter().any(|ancestor| ancestor == scope) {
109	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
110	                "campaign refused: sub-goal scope '{scope}' cycles to an ancestor\n\
111	                 try: launch the campaign from a different checkout"
112	            )));
113	        }
114	    }
115	    Ok(())
116	}

229	/// Turn planner output (N sub-goal strings) into validated [`SubGoal`]s. Refuses a
230	/// count that does not match the request, an empty sub-goal, or a duplicate
231	/// (whitespace- and case-normalized).
232	pub fn build_sub_goals(goals: Vec<String>, requested_n: usize) -> Result<Vec<SubGoal>> {
233	    if goals.len() != requested_n {
234	        return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
235	            "campaign planner returned {} sub-goals; expected exactly {requested_n}",
236	            goals.len()
237	        )));
238	    }
239	    validate_task_count(goals.len())?;
240	    let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
241	    let mut subs = Vec::with_capacity(goals.len());
242	    for (index, goal) in goals.into_iter().enumerate() {
243	        let trimmed = goal.trim();
244	        if trimmed.is_empty() {
245	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(
246	                "campaign sub-goal must not be empty".to_string(),
247	            ));
248	        }
249	        let normalized = trimmed
250	            .split_whitespace()
251	            .collect::<Vec<_>>()
252	            .join(" ")
253	            .to_ascii_lowercase();
254	        if !seen.insert(normalized) {
255	            return Err(DeadreckonError::InvalidInput(format!(
256	                "duplicate campaign sub-goal: {trimmed}"
257	            )));
258	        }
259	        subs.push(SubGoal {
260	            sub_id: format!("sub-{index}"),
261	            goal: trimmed.to_string(),
262	            task_key: crate::paths::task_key(trimmed),
263	            sub_plan_id: None,
264	            result_run_id: None,
265	            scope: None,
266	            status: SubGoalStatus::Pending,
267	        });
268	    }
269	    Ok(subs)
270	}

419	        Err(source) => Err(DeadreckonError::Io { path, source }),
420	    }
421	}
422	
423	/// Split a campaign's tree-wide spend ceiling evenly across N sub-orchestrators.
424	/// Computed in whole cents so the shares sum back to the ceiling exactly; any
425	/// leftover cent goes to the earliest subs (remainder-to-first).
426	pub fn allocate_budget(tree_budget: f64, n: usize) -> Vec<f64> {
427	    if n == 0 {
428	        return Vec::new();
429	    }
430	    let total_cents = (tree_budget * 100.0).round() as i64;
431	    let base = total_cents / n as i64;
432	    let remainder = total_cents - base * n as i64;
433	    (0..n)
434	        .map(|index| {
435	            let cents = if (index as i64) < remainder {
436	                base + 1
437	            } else {
438	                base
439	            };
440	            cents as f64 / 100.0
441	        })
442	        .collect()
443	}
444	
445	/// Whether the aggregate spend across already-launched leaf runs has reached the
446	/// campaign's tree ceiling. An absent ceiling is never exhausted.
447	pub fn tree_budget_exhausted(tree_budget: Option<f64>, spent_usd: f64) -> bool {
448	    tree_budget.is_some_and(|cap| spent_usd >= cap)
449	}
450	
451	/// The warning to surface when a campaign runs with no tree budget: each
452	/// sub-orchestrator falls back to the default per-run cap, so the whole tree is
453	/// unbounded. Returns `None` when a ceiling is set.
454	pub fn unbounded_budget_warning(tree_budget: Option<f64>) -> Option<String> {
455	    if tree_budget.is_none() {
456	        Some(
457	            "campaign tree budget is unbounded: each sub-orchestrator inherits the default \
458	             per-run cap. pass --max-spend to bound the whole tree"
459	                .to_string(),
460	        )
461	    } else {
462	        None
463	    }
464	}
465	
466	const ROLLUP_FILE: &str = "campaign-rollup.json";
467	
468	/// The aggregate trust verdict of a campaign, worst-of across every leaf run.
469	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
470	#[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
471	pub enum RollupVerdict {
472	    Clean,
473	    Caveat,
474	    Refused,
475	}
476	
477	/// One leaf run's contribution to the roll-up.
478	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
479	pub struct LeafVerdict {
480	    pub sub_id: String,
481	    #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
482	    pub result_run_id: Option<String>,
483	    /// "signed" | "refused" | "missing" — whether the leaf produced a valid gate.
484	    pub gate: String,
485	    pub tamper_verdict: AcceptanceTamperVerdict,
486	    #[serde(default)]
487	    pub caveats: Vec<String>,
488	}
489	
490	impl LeafVerdict {
491	    /// The leaf's effective trust verdict: a leaf with no valid signed gate counts
492	    /// as refused regardless of its tamper verdict.
493	    pub fn effective(&self) -> RollupVerdict {
494	        if self.gate != "signed" {
495	            return RollupVerdict::Refused;
496	        }
497	        match self.tamper_verdict {
498	            AcceptanceTamperVerdict::Clean => RollupVerdict::Clean,
499	            AcceptanceTamperVerdict::Caveat => RollupVerdict::Caveat,
500	            AcceptanceTamperVerdict::Refuse => RollupVerdict::Refused,
501	        }
502	    }
503	}
504	
505	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
506	pub struct CampaignRollup {
507	    pub schema_version: u32,
508	    pub campaign_id: String,
509	    pub evaluated_at: DateTime<Utc>,
510	    pub leaves: Vec<LeafVerdict>,
511	    pub rollup_verdict: RollupVerdict,
512	    pub refused_subs: Vec<String>,
513	    pub caveat_subs: Vec<String>,
514	}
515	
516	/// Worst-of across leaf verdicts: any refused wins, else any caveat, else clean.
517	/// An empty leaf set is refused (a campaign with nothing merged is not clean).
518	pub fn worst_of(verdicts: &[RollupVerdict]) -> RollupVerdict {
519	    if verdicts.is_empty() {
520	        return RollupVerdict::Refused;
521	    }
522	    if verdicts.contains(&RollupVerdict::Refused) {
523	        RollupVerdict::Refused
524	    } else if verdicts.contains(&RollupVerdict::Caveat) {
525	        RollupVerdict::Caveat
526	    } else {
527	        RollupVerdict::Clean
528	    }
529	}
530	
531	/// A campaign may reach clean completion only if no leaf was refused. This is the
532	/// no-laundering invariant: nesting cannot turn a refused leaf into a clean result.
533	pub fn rollup_permits_completion(verdict: RollupVerdict) -> bool {
534	    verdict != RollupVerdict::Refused
535	}
536	
537	/// Build the roll-up from a campaign and a per-leaf lookup that yields each result
538	/// run's gate state, tamper verdict, and caveats. A sub with no merged result run
539	/// is recorded as a missing (refused) leaf.
540	pub fn build_rollup<F>(campaign: &Campaign, mut leaf_lookup: F) -> CampaignRollup
541	where
542	    F: FnMut(&str) -> (String, AcceptanceTamperVerdict, Vec<String>),
543	{
544	    let mut leaves = Vec::new();
545	    for sub in &campaign.sub_goals {
546	        let leaf = match sub.result_run_id.as_deref() {
547	            Some(run_id) => {
548	                let (gate, tamper_verdict, caveats) = leaf_lookup(run_id);
549	                LeafVerdict {
550	                    sub_id: sub.sub_id.clone(),
551	                    result_run_id: Some(run_id.to_string()),
552	                    gate,
553	                    tamper_verdict,
554	                    caveats,
555	                }
556	            }
557	            None => LeafVerdict {
558	                sub_id: sub.sub_id.clone(),
559	                result_run_id: None,
560	                gate: "missing".to_string(),
561	                tamper_verdict: AcceptanceTamperVerdict::Refuse,
562	                caveats: Vec::new(),
563	            },
564	        };
565	        leaves.push(leaf);
566	    }
567	    let effective: Vec<RollupVerdict> = leaves.iter().map(LeafVerdict::effective).collect();
568	    let refused_subs = leaves
569	        .iter()
570	        .filter(|leaf| leaf.effective() == RollupVerdict::Refused)
571	        .map(|leaf| leaf.sub_id.clone())
572	        .collect();
573	    let caveat_subs = leaves
574	        .iter()
575	        .filter(|leaf| leaf.effective() == RollupVerdict::Caveat)
576	        .map(|leaf| leaf.sub_id.clone())
577	        .collect();
578	    CampaignRollup {
579	        schema_version: 1,
580	        campaign_id: campaign.campaign_id.clone(),
581	        evaluated_at: Utc::now(),
582	        leaves,
583	        rollup_verdict: worst_of(&effective),
584	        refused_subs,
585	        caveat_subs,
586	    }
587	}
588	
589	/// A campaign reaches clean completion only when every sub merged *and* the
590	/// roll-up permits completion (no refused leaf). This is where the no-laundering
591	/// invariant meets the all-subs-done requirement.
592	pub fn campaign_can_complete(campaign: &Campaign, rollup: &CampaignRollup) -> bool {
593	    campaign
594	        .sub_goals
595	        .iter()
596	        .all(|sub| sub.status == SubGoalStatus::Merged)
597	        && rollup_permits_completion(rollup.rollup_verdict)
598	}
599	
600	pub fn rollup_path_for_plan_dir(plan_dir: &Path) -> PathBuf {
601	    plan_dir.join(ROLLUP_FILE)
602	}
603	
604	/// Where a campaign result run carries its bound roll-up (hashed into the run's
605	/// acceptance-marker signature by the gate).
606	pub fn rollup_path_at_run_root(run_root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
607	    run_root.join(ROLLUP_FILE)
608	}
609	
610	pub fn write_campaign_rollup(plan_dir: &Path, rollup: &CampaignRollup) -> Result<()> {
611	    crate::state::atomic_write_json(&rollup_path_for_plan_dir(plan_dir), rollup)
612	}
613	
614	/// Write the roll-up into a result run's root so the gate binds it into the
615	/// acceptance-marker signature (the no-laundering guarantee).
616	pub fn write_campaign_rollup_at_run_root(run_root: &Path, rollup: &CampaignRollup) -> Result<()> {
617	    crate::state::atomic_write_json(&rollup_path_at_run_root(run_root), rollup)
618	}
619	
620	pub fn read_campaign_rollup(plan_dir: &Path) -> Result<CampaignRollup> {
621	    let path = rollup_path_for_plan_dir(plan_dir);
622	    let bytes = std::fs::read(&path).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Io {
623	        path: path.clone(),
624	        source,
625	    })?;
626	    serde_json::from_slice(&bytes).map_err(|source| DeadreckonError::Json { path, source })
627	}
